title: Probability weighted complex inner product
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $p$ on $\Omega$, and functions $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$, define their probability weighted complex inner product as $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)\,\overline{f(x)}g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
